name: Caledonia Life

ring.prompt: Caledonia Life. Calls are recorded. If you are calling about a bereavement, please stay on the line.

menu.prompt: For new policies, press one. For claims, press two. For bereavement notifications, press three.

holdAnnouncement: Please continue to hold. A member of our specialist team will answer as soon as possible.

clerk.greeting: Specialist team, Alan speaking. My condolences. May I take the policyholder's full name and date of death?

turns.reprompt: Could you repeat the date of death for me? I need it exactly as on the certificate.

outcome.closing: That's noted, and the policy is flagged. Your reference is {REF}. The claims pack goes out to the executor today. Thank you for letting us know.

quirk: Date precision matters here — the captured-mishear replay (13th vs 30th) lives on this line: the validator rejects the misheard date and the agent re-asks.
